description: Returns the details for a single contributing behavior identified by its ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the contributing behavior. Returned as id in List and Show responses.

id.description: Unique identifier of the contributing behavior.

name.description: Translated display name of the contributing behavior.

name_key.description: Untranslated name of the contributing behavior, matching the original value stored in the database.

active.description: Whether this contributing behavior is available for selection on incident records. When false, existing references are preserved but new assignments are prevented.

global.description: Whether this contributing behavior is a Procore-provided default. Global contributing behaviors cannot be deleted and their names cannot be changed.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this contributing behavior was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this contributing behavior was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.
